A pay-per-call First-Principles Inquiry Method Pack for evaluating ideas, proposals and decisions. After payment the full method is returned immediately: six stages (goal, question to ask, exit criterion, common mistake), five evidence checks, a seven-column premise ledger, a seven-part report skeleton, six guardrails and two examples, driven by the caller's own model.

What you receive is the method, not analysis of a specific question. The question parameter is only echoed back for reconciliation and logging. If you expect to submit a question and receive an answer, this pack is not for you.
